# Sheytoni (شیطونی)

> Sheytoni is a social community platform for profiles, posts, reels, messaging, and creator monetization via Telegram Stars.

## What is Sheytoni?

Sheytoni (pronounced "Shey-toni", Persian: شیطونی) is an adult-oriented social network delivered as a Telegram Mini App. Users create profiles, publish posts with media, follow others, chat privately, and support creators with Telegram Stars.

## Features

- User profiles with avatar, cover, bio, and verification badges
- Social feed with posts, likes, comments, bookmarks
- Short-form video reels
- Private messaging with media albums
- Paid media unlocks via Telegram Stars
- Creator earnings and analytics
